title: Greimas — Actantial Model
license: system/idea (not copyrightable); descriptions authored for monomyth
tier_note: Six actants on three axes. More general than Propp's roles; the clean relational layer — every character in a scene fills one or more actant slots. Actants are functions, not characters: one character may be several actants; one actant may be several characters or an abstraction.

items.name: Subject
items.description: The one who desires and pursues the object; typically the hero.

items.name: Object
items.description: That which is desired/sought — a person, thing, goal, or state.

items.name: Sender
items.description: The one who initiates the quest and dispatches the subject toward the object.

items.name: Receiver
items.description: The one who benefits from the object being obtained (often the subject themselves).

items.name: Helper
items.description: Aids the subject in obtaining the object.

items.name: Opponent
items.description: Hinders the subject and opposes the acquisition of the object.
